name: final paired evaluation
scenario: spec = random_spec(default_rng(900000 + seed)); Simulator(spec, seed, duration_s); one decision per 500 ms window; every arm starts from the same isolated policy

base_r6.role: reference: the base scheduler as delivered, greedy

loop_a.role: candidate: Step A loop, members and Params from the Step A config

loop_b.role: candidate: Step B loop, members, Step A Params and reviser from the Step B config

random_selection.role: ablation, lower bound: uniform choice among the same candidates

oracle_selection.role: ablation, upper bound: candidates ranked by the real simulator

loop_no_uncertainty.role: ablation: Step A without the disagreement penalty

loop_no_fallback.role: ablation: Step A without the trust gate and fallback

adaptive_c9.role: non-ML feedback baseline, configuration 9 of the sibling's adaptive grid

metrics.primary: value_per_s: (B batches x value + C core-ms x value) per second, as the RL reward
metrics.slo: window-violation % of A's p99 SLO; v2 (sees queued requests) is primary, v1 reported
metrics.run_time_model_probe: arms that rank with the ensemble: every probe_every-th model decision, every candidate run for H windows in a copy of the real simulator after the decision is timed; GRU error = mean |ensemble-mean forecast - real| on the disagreement keys in training-std units; rank agreement = Spearman of predicted vs real reward over candidates

success_rule.value: paired 95% CI of (candidate - base_r6) value_per_s lies above zero
success_rule.slo: paired upper 95% bound of (candidate - base_r6) slo_v2_pct <= +1.0 percentage point
success_rule.decision_time: worst per-scenario p95 <= 50 ms and max <= 500 ms at normal priority, from experiments/time_decisions.py (results/step_a/timing.md, results/step_b/timing.md); decision time measured in this run is under background QoS and reported only
success_rule.pairs: per scenario, over the scenarios where both arms succeeded; Student-t CI
success_rule.otherwise: any other result is reported as it is; a CI including zero is no detectable difference

secondary.why: headroom left in the candidate set
value of the trust gate and fallback

failure_handling: a run that raises is recorded with a scrubbed message and listed, never dropped or replaced; comparisons use the scenarios where both arms succeeded. A crash or a bug: fix, rerun as the next attempt, report every attempt; no tuning on these results.
